verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing advertises 'fast global payments' with its business account, so it documents sending money abroad. Nothing quantifies the speed or shows international transfers settling within a minute, and the Payments API lists only ACH, domestic wires, and checks. missing for 10: documented sub-minute international settlement, documented international wire/FX payment rails or API support, independent or hands-on corroboration of transfer speed.

support.subject: As a founder, I can send money abroad that arrives in under a minute
